# Archive fixtures

Archives made by tools this repo cannot run (7-Zip, WinRAR), from libarchive's test suite
(`libarchive/test/test_read_format_*.uu`, BSD 2-clause, Copyright (c) 2003-2024 Tim Kientzle and
the libarchive contributors), uudecoded. The 7z ones use the password `12345678`; the RAR ones
`password` (and `password2` for one member), as their libarchive tests say.
